intro: Tonga has about 100,000 people, and many Tongans live abroad.

chapters.title: People
text: Almost everyone is Tongan. Tongan and English are official. Church is central to life, and Sunday is a strict day of rest by law.

chapters.title: Nuku'alofa
text: Nuku'alofa, on Tongatapu, is the capital.

keyTerms.meaning: A woven mat worn around the waist.
